title: UPDATE: At Least Four Analysts Downgrade Infosys Following Annual Revenue Guidance Cut
summary:
The Indian software exporter saw its stock ratings tumble on Oct. 27 as at least four analysts downgraded the firm in a single day. The wave of cuts followed a reduction in the company's annual revenue outlook, highlighting growing investor anxiety that artificial intelligence is beginning to disrupt the traditional business models of the IT outsourcing sector.

Infosys shares fell 7.7% in U.S. pre-market trading after the company lowered its FY27 constant currency revenue growth forecast to a range of 1% to 2%. The revised guidance comes as corporate clients scale back expenditures on IT projects, contributing to a second-quarter revenue of $5.15B that missed estimates of $5.19B.
